text.tspan: Write with a deterministic SOP. Evolve it from exemplar papers.
Two Agent Skills around one shared core: the model reasons and writes; scripts measure, check and decide.
every branch ends in a script check (exit 0) · failure: diagnose, fix, rerun ≤ 3×, then report
read by ①, improved by ②
keep best · revert on score drop
deterministic check, decides by exit code
